pages.title: Antimatter Penning Trap
pages.text: Pair-produces antimatter from gamma photons and holds it in a magnetic bottle.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.

Physics, briefly: a gamma photon with enough energy can become a particle and its antiparticle at once - $(thing)pair production$(), E = mc² run backwards. Antimatter annihilates on touching anything, so a $(thing)Penning trap$() holds it in vacuum with electric and magnetic fields alone. I check the seals twice a day.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Annihilation Core, Antihydrogen Crystal, Antimatter Pellet.
$(thing)Where these go$():$(li)$(item)Antimatter Penning Trap$(): Antiproton Decelerator, Penning Harness
